sentences.text: Prakash Bhuiyan @ Prakash Kumar, aged about 33 years, S/o. Nageshwar Bhuiya, R/o. Vill.- Hewai Kalan, P.O. & P.S.- Keredari, Dist. Hazaribag.
CORAM: - HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE AMBUJ NATH ------

For the Petitioner : Mr. S. Hamadul Haque, Advocate For the State : Mr. Sanjay Kumar Srivastava,
A.P.P.
------
02/08.09.2025 Heard the parties.

2. The petitioner has been made accused in connection with S.T. Case No. 89/2025 arising out of Keredari P.S. Case No. 67 of 2010, corresponding to G.R. Case No. 3197 of 2010, for the offences registered under Sections 366A/34 of the Indian Penal Code subsequently, charge- sheet has been submitted under Sections 366A/34/376 of the Indian Penal Code, pending in the court of learned Addl. Sessions Judge-I, Hazaribag.
3. Petitioner and co-accused persons had enticed daughter of the informant with an intention that she will get married to this petitioner.

sentences.text: It was submitted that several co-accused persons have been granted bail by learned Sessions Court itself.

It was further submitted that co- accused Khusboo Devi has been granted bail by this Court earlier vide B.A. No. 209/2025.
5.
In view of the submissions made above, I am inclined to release the petitioner, on bail.

Accordingly, the petitioner, named above, is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 20,000/- (Rupees Twenty Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of learned Addl. Sessions Judge-I, Hazaribag in connection with S.T. Case No. 89/2025 arising out of Keredari P.S. Case No. 67 of 2010, corresponding to G.R. Case No. 3197 of 2010.
